description: A tool's releases and changelog entries, newest first, each with its date, version, the vendor's own page and a quote from it - read from the vendor's GitHub releases or the feed its site declares. "disputed": two sources give dates over a week apart; every source is listed. Empty lists mean the Atlas reads no source for it, not that nothing shipped. Page with `before` (the `next` value).

before.description: ISO date: only events before it (the previous answer's `next`).

domain.description: The tool's domain, e.g. "n8n.io"; resolve a name with atlas_search first.

name: get_project_timeline
title: What a tool shipped
